transcript.statement: The requirements proposed by the TrustworthinessAgent prioritize the security and privacy of user transactions. TRU-01 ensures that all transactions are encrypted during transmission, safeguarding sensitive data from interception. TRU-02 emphasizes secure PIN authentication, preventing unauthorized access. TRU-03 mandates logging transactions with timestamps, enabling robust auditing. TRU-04 prevents negative balances, reinforcing integrity. TRU-05 allows users to securely review their transaction history, enhancing transparency. TRU-06 ensures users are notified of insufficient funds, protecting against unintended overdrafts. TRU-07 maintains data integrity through validation of operations against business rules. Together, these requirements establish a solid foundation for trust in the ATM system.

transcript.statement: The GreenAgent emphasizes the importance of sustainability in the ATM system. GRN-01 aims to minimize energy consumption, while GRN-02 provides transparency by reporting the carbon footprint of each transaction. GRN-03 focuses on utilizing energy-efficient hardware, and GRN-04 ensures that transaction logging is optimized for minimal data storage impact. GRN-05 promotes electronic records to reduce paper waste. GRN-06 ensures energy savings through automatic shutdown during inactivity, and GRN-07 highlights the need for annual assessments of environmental impact. Together, these requirements ensure the ATM system operates in an environmentally responsible manner.

transcript.statement: The ResponsibilityAgent prioritizes ethical standards and compliance in the ATM system. RES-01 ensures adherence to financial regulations, safeguarding accountability. RES-02 mandates transaction logs for transparency, while RES-03 prevents negative balances, promoting fairness. RES-04 emphasizes secure PIN authentication for user accountability. RES-05 guarantees funds are only withdrawn when available, ensuring responsible financial practices. RES-06 addresses user notification for insufficient funds, fostering fairness in transactions. RES-07 upholds user privacy through data encryption, reinforcing social responsibility. These requirements collectively ensure that the ATM system operates with integrity and accountability.

transcript.statement: The EfficiencyAgent emphasizes the importance of performance efficiency in the ATM system. EFF-01 ensures transactions are processed quickly, enhancing user experience. EFF-02 maintains high throughput, allowing more users to transact simultaneously. EFF-03 optimizes data retrieval to reduce latency when accessing transaction history. EFF-04 complements the safety requirements by preventing negative balances efficiently. EFF-05 aims for seamless user experience by minimizing delays in fund withdrawals. EFF-06 provides immediate feedback for withdrawal requests, improving responsiveness. EFF-07 implements load balancing, ensuring optimal resource management during peak times. Together, these requirements enhance the ATM's overall performance and user satisfaction.

transcript.statement: The SafetyAgent emphasizes the critical importance of safety and reliability in the ATM system. SAF-01 ensures accounts do not enter negative balances, safeguarding users from financial mishaps. SAF-02 establishes a mechanism for automatic fund withdrawal from savings, enhancing reliability during transactions. SAF-03 ensures users are informed of insufficient funds, preventing unexpected overdrafts. SAF-04 mandates transaction logging for accountability and auditing. SAF-05 provides secure PIN verification, protecting user accounts. SAF-06 allows for safe degradation during maintenance, and SAF-07 ensures users receive clear summaries post-transactions. Together, these requirements establish a robust safety framework for the ATM system.

requirements.text: The system shall provide a secure mechanism for user authentication, ensuring data integrity and preventing unauthorized access.
The system shall maintain comprehensive transaction logs for auditability and compliance with financial regulations.
The system shall prevent transactions that result in negative account balances while ensuring rapid processing of transactions.
The system shall inform users immediately of insufficient funds during transactions to uphold user accountability.
The system shall optimize transaction processing to minimize energy consumption while maintaining performance standards.
The system shall allow clients to receive electronic transaction records instead of paper receipts to reduce waste.
The system shall implement measures for safe degradation during maintenance to ensure continued user access.
The system shall ensure that all transactions are encrypted during transmission to protect user data.
The system shall provide a clear summary of account status after each transaction to enhance user understanding.
The ATM system shall assess its environmental impact annually and report findings to stakeholders.
